user.title: Choose the cover
user.description: Choose the real cover to wrap (for example the Overkiz cover). The new cover is placed under the same device.

data_description.source_entity: The cover entity that receives the commands.

parametres.title: Cover settings
parametres.description: Real cover: {source}. Time a complete trip of the cover, fully closed to fully open and back.

data_description.name: The name shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.travel_time_up: Seconds needed for a complete opening.
data_description.travel_time_down: Seconds needed for a complete closing.
data_description.send_stop_at_ends: After a complete opening or closing, still send a stop command. Only useful if the cover does not stop by itself.
data_description.hide_source: The original cover no longer appears in the interface so it is not used by mistake. It is still used internally to send commands. It is shown again if this timed cover is removed.

error.source_deja_chronometree: This cover is already a timed cover: choose the real cover.

init.title: Cover settings
init.description: Changes apply immediately. The current position is kept.

data_description.travel_time_up: Seconds needed for a complete opening.

set_known_position.name: Set known position
set_known_position.description: Tell the real position of the cover without moving it.
